title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

 **defined first\-response SLAs,**

 **fast, accurate first response**

 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard**

 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.**

 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.

**Triage \& Severity Classification**

description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

We have a PAN\-India presence, with world\-class engineering delivery centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata.
   

  

 Challenging Today…Reinventing Tomorrow.
   

  

 Jacobs is seeking a
 **Associate Director\- Protection \& Control** 
 to support a range of high\-profile projects across our Power \& Energy portfolio. In this role, you will serve as a global Subject Matter Expert – Protection \& Control, IEC 61850 \& Digital Substations providing advanced technical leadership for protection and control engineering across substations, transmission and distribution systems, renewable interconnections, industrial power networks and digital grid infrastructure.
   

  

 The SME will act as a technical authority for conventional, hybrid and fully digital substations, supporting projects across global markets including UK, Australia, Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia\-Pacific. The role requires deep domain expertise in protection schemes, relay settings, substation automation, IEC 61850 integration, SCADA interfaces, cybersecurity, commissioning support and future\-ready digital substation technologies.
   

  

**The Primary Responsibilities Would Be**
**Protection \& Control Engineering**
* Provide specialist technical leadership for protection and control design of medium voltage, high voltage and extra high voltage substations.
* Lead, review and technically assure protection schemes for
+ Line protection
+ Transformer protection
+ Busbar protection
+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection
+ SVC / STATCOM protection
+ Renewable and BESS interconnection protection
+ Industrial power network protection
+ Grid connection and interconnection protection

* Lead and review key engineering deliverables including
+ Protection Single Line Diagrams / Key Line Diagrams
+ Protection and control schematics
+ Control logic diagrams
+ Trip and alarm matrix
+ AC/DC auxiliary schematics
+ Panel GA and BOQ
+ Wiring diagrams
+ Interface drawings
+ Interconnection schedules
+ Cable schedules
+ Relay assembled forms
+ Test and commissioning documentation

* Provide expert review of relay setting calculations and protection coordination studies.
* Review and approve relay settings, protection philosophies, technical reports and protection coordination documents.
* Provide technical direction for distance protection, differential protection, overcurrent protection, earth fault protection, REF, synchro\-check, auto\-reclose, breaker failure and busbar protection applications.
* Support fault level studies, protection grading, grid code compliance and system performance validation.
* Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, energization and post\-energization troubleshooting.
* Review vendor drawings, relay configuration files, test procedures, test reports and as\-built documentation.


**IEC 61850 Integration and Digital Substations**
* Lead advanced engineering for IEC 61850\-based digital substations, including concept design, detailed design, configuration strategy, integration, testing and commissioning support.
* Define and review complete digital substation architecture including
+ Station bus
+ Process bus
+ Protection IEDs
+ Merging units
+ SCADA gateways
+ HMI systems
+ Engineering workstations
+ Network switches
+ Time synchronization systems

* Provide expert guidance on IEC 61850 applications including
+ GOOSE messaging
+ MMS communication
+ Sampled Values
+ Logical nodes and data modelling
+ Dataset configuration
+ Report control blocks
+ GOOSE control blocks
+ Sampled Value control blocks
+ Multi\-vendor interoperability

* Lead preparation and review of IEC 61850 deliverables including
+ IEC 61850 architecture drawings
+ Communication architecture
+ IED capability assessment
+ Signal lists and data point schedules
+ GOOSE mapping schedules
+ MMS mapping schedules
+ Sampled Value design documents
+ Logical node mapping
+ ICD, CID, IID, SCD and SSD file review records
+ FAT/SAT procedures for IEC 61850 systems

* Provide expert review and validation of IEC 61850 configuration files and ensure consistency between drawings, relay configuration, automation configuration and SCADA mapping.
* Lead or support multi\-vendor integration involving Siemens, Hitachi Energy / ABB, GE Vernova, Schneider Electric, SEL, NR Electric and other global OEMs.
* Support digital substation testing using tools such as Omicron, Doble, Wireshark, IEDScout, StationScout, IET600, DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista and equivalent platforms.
* Guide project teams on migration from conventional hardwired systems to hybrid or fully digital substation architecture.
* Develop digital substation templates, standard architectures, reusable design libraries and configuration governance processes.


**Substation Automation, SCADA and Communication Networks**
* Provide technical leadership for substation automation systems, SCADA integration, RTU/Gateway interfaces, HMI systems and control centre communication.
* Review communication protocols and interfaces including IEC 61850, IEC 60870\-5\-101/104, IEC 60870\-5\-103, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP and synchrophasor interfaces where applicable.
* Lead design and review of digital substation communication networks including
+ Ethernet LAN architecture
+ Managed switch configuration philosophy
+ VLANs and IP addressing
+ Multicast management
+ PRP / HSR redundancy
+ Network segmentation
+ Remote engineering access
+ Network monitoring and diagnostics

* Provide guidance on time synchronization systems including IEEE 1588 PTP, SNTP, IRIG\-B and GPS\-based time sources.
* Review communication architecture for high availability, resilience and reliable operation of critical protection and control systems.


**Cybersecurity Considerations**
* Provide technical leadership on cybersecurity requirements for protection, control, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across the engineering lifecycle from concept design through commissioning and handover.
* Review designs against relevant cybersecurity standards and requirements such as IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP where applicable, utility standards and client\-specific cybersecurity requirements.
* Provide guidance on secure substation architecture including
+ Network segmentation
+ Defense\-in\-depth design
+ Secure remote access
+ Role\-based access control
+ User authentication
+ Password and credential management
+ Firewall and gateway interface requirements
+ Secure engineering access
+ Logging and event monitoring
+ Asset inventory
+ Patch and firmware management considerations
+ Backup and recovery strategy
+ Configuration file control
+ IED, gateway, HMI and workstation hardening

* Define cybersecurity requirements for vendors and OEMs during specification, procurement, FAT, SAT and commissioning stages.
* Support cybersecurity risk reviews for IEC 61850 systems, SCADA links, remote access, vendor interfaces and third\-party equipment.
* Promote secure\-by\-design principles for digital substations, renewable plants and future grid automation systems.


**Renewable Energy, Grid Connection And Future Capabilities**
* Provide SME support for solar, wind, battery energy storage, hybrid renewable plants, collector substations and grid interconnection facilities.
* Support protection design for inverter\-based resources, weak grids, low fault current networks and changing grid behaviour.

+ Digital substations
+ Process bus implementation
+ Centralized protection systems
+ Virtual protection and control concepts
+ Wide Area Monitoring, Protection and Control

+ Digital twin for substations
+ Model\-based engineering
+ Automated relay setting workflows
+ AI\-assisted engineering checks

+ Cyber\-secure remote commissioning

* Act as the highest level of technical support for complex protection, control, automation and digital substation issues.
* Provide independent technical review, design assurance and quality validation for critical deliverables.
* Ensure engineering outputs comply with client specifications, utility standards, grid codes, IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations, regional requirements and Jacobs quality procedures.

* BE / B Tech / ME / M Tech in Electrical Engineering.

* Strong experience in MV, HV and EHV substation protection and control systems.

description:
**Title**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Senior Administrator, Systems
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for overseeing and providing the installation, maintenance, support and enhancement to the Company computing infrastructure. Areas of responsibility include Windows and Linux Operating Systems , Active Directory , Azure/Entra, Office365, VMWare, Backup and Cloud technologies. The Senior Systems Administrator recommends technology decisions to Management and directs operational processes to Systems Administrators for the ICU Medical Global Computing environment.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Create the Architecture; implement, configure, and support all enterprise computing systems globally.
* Create standards and documentation for the Global computing environments.
* Participate in creating and following the directives in the Infrastructure Strategic plan.
* Adhere to all Service Level Agreements established with the user community.
* Create reports and establish operational guidelines for the Global Computing Environments.
* Create automated monitoring to alert Systems Administrators and Service Desk staff of disruptions of service.
* Participate in vendor management under the direction of the department manager.
* Architect, implement, and support virtual and standalone server and storage solutions.
* Benchmark, evaluate and make recommendations for the selection of server and storage management software and hardware products.
* Develop and implement business continuity practices for server and storage management.
* Monitor server and storage performance, diagnose server issues, and perform emergency and scheduled maintenance.
* Provide support to operations relating to server and storage administration problems.
* Maintain server and storage configurations to provide performance monitoring/tuning of enterprise environments.
* Keep the Information Systems staff and customers informed of the status and resolution of issues; update the Service Desk software with resolutions and status.
* Participate in strategic initiatives by performing technical project activities.
* Evaluate server system and storage upgrades and management software patches.
* Prepare monthly status reports (or implement web\-based reports) quantitatively reporting server and storage capacity, performance and uptime.
* Responsible for securing server and storage resources including password maintenance, new user logon and setup, and data protection procedures.
* Create and maintain automated systems and procedures for storage and server operations.
* Assist Service Desk staff in streamlining daily operations.
* Coordinate with user community scheduling times and user procedures necessary for server and storage system upgrades and/or maintenance.
* Work to minimize downtime impact on users through accurate planning of scheduled downtimes and quick problem resolution for unscheduled downtimes.
* Follow the established standards for writing and documenting projects and server and storage configurations.
* Contribute to the development of new standards and/or the modification of existing standards.
* Participate in the 24/7 department on\-call program.
* Work on special assignments as they arise.


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Operating Systems
* Strong knowledge of Office 365 environments
* Experience with PowerShell and using scripting to automate configuration management
* Experience with automation platforms such as SCORCH, MoveIT Automate, VMWare Orchestrator
* Experience with Azure cloud services
* Experience with DFS, CIFS, and print services
* Experience with VDI technologies. Preferably RDS and Horizon
* Experience with MSSQL and basic MSSQL management functions
* Strong knowledge in supporting enterprise backup solutions and troubleshooting backup issues
* Strong knowledge of data center technologies; Virtualization, Storage, Servers
* Understanding or experience supporting .Net application servers
* Knowledge of budget reductions, standardized processes, and operational automation.
* Strong customer service skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent collaboration skills and able to work in a team environment
* Able to work quickly and effectively under pressure and to efficiently handle multiple priorities simultaneously


**Minimum Qualifications, Education \& Experience**
* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related IT field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in server/user administration, virtualization and storage in a global enterprise environment
* Microsoft certification preferred
* Strong experience in virtual/physical server and storage technologies
* Experience in developing and implementing business continuity and disaster recovery practices
* Experience in data backup technologies
* Experience planning and leading global small to medium scale server related projects


**Work Environment**
* This is largely a sedentary role.
* This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment.
* Typically requires travel less than 15% of the time.
